response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile Staff-level software engineer with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills, DevOps ability, and a track record of teaching and mentoring, but his resume shows almost no substantive experience with the core requirements of this GenAI role: no Python, no RAG or vector database work, no LLM evaluation/optimization, minimal cloud platform depth (a single AWS CDK mention), and only ~4 months of exposure to AI-agent/MCP tooling in his current role. The job requires 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions, which he clearly does not have.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience with Staff/Senior titles across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded)
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and teaching ability (workshops, talks, Selenium course)
Current exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) tooling and agentic workflow infrastructure at re:cinq
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience, and no evidence of RAG, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/optimization work
AI/GenAI-specific experience is extremely recent (~4 months) and vaguely described, far short of the required 8+ years in AI-driven solutions
Minimal cloud platform depth (only a single mention of AWS CDK) versus the role's emphasis on major cloud platform AI system design

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering seniority and leadership/mentoring background
